title: Nourishing Slovakian Clams Pilaf
description: A rich and fluffy Slovakian dish featuring clams, this pilaf is a nostalgic and keto-friendly meal option, cooked to perfection on a slate tile vessel.
instructions: Preheat the slate tile vessel over medium heat, adding 2 tablespoons of butter to melt.
Add the chopped onion to the vessel and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the vessel and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the paprika, salt, and black pepper to the vessel, stirring to combine.
Add the clams to the vessel, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add the cauliflower rice to the vessel, stirring to combine with the clam mixture.
Add the chicken broth to the vessel, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the pilaf is fluffy.
Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until melted and well combined.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
